meta.title: Session Rewind
meta.description: In-place conversation rewind: withdraw everything after a chosen user message, optionally restore the files those turns changed, and put it back in the composer. Esc Esc or the ↶ button opens it.

sessionRewind.dialog.title: Rewind
sessionRewind.dialog.desc: Restore this conversation to an earlier message.
sessionRewind.dialog.descConfirm: Remove this message and everything after it from the conversation.
sessionRewind.dialog.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable; this will rewind the conversation only.
sessionRewind.confirm.summary: This truncates {n} context record(s) ({messages} user/assistant message(s), about {tokens} tokens).
sessionRewind.confirm.modeChatHint: Truncates the model context only; workspace files stay untouched. Withdrawn content stays in the panel.
sessionRewind.confirm.modeBothHint: Truncates context and rewrites workspace files (restore / move to trash); a rescue point is created first and can be restored from the panel.
sessionRewind.confirm.filesNone: No trackable file changes in this rewind
sessionRewind.confirm.filesConflicts: {n} file(s) differ from the expected state; file rewind is unavailable
sessionRewind.confirm.fileSummary: Restore {restored} file(s), move {trashed} new file(s) to trash
sessionRewind.confirm.restoreDeleted: {n} of them were deleted and will be recreated
sessionRewind.confirm.trackingScope: File rewind only covers changes made inside this session's working directory by write / edit / apply_patch; bash, scripts, subagent edits and changes outside the workspace are not tracked.
sessionRewind.confirm.recoverable: The context cut cannot be undone, but the withdrawn content stays in the Withdrawn tab — copy it or put it back in the composer.
sessionRewind.confirm.recoverableFiles: A rescue point is created before any file write, and newly created files go to the plugin trash; both can be restored from the panel.
sessionRewind.confirm.busy: The turn is still running: rewinding stops it first and drops any queued steering messages.
sessionRewind.confirm.openToolCall: An unfinished tool call follows the target; rewinding truncates it.
sessionRewind.toast.done: Rewound. The original message is back in the composer.
sessionRewind.toast.draft: Rewound. The composer already had content, so it was kept.
sessionRewind.toast.noComposer: Rewound, but no composer was found.
sessionRewind.toast.rewound: Rewound: truncated {n} context record(s) (withdrew {messages} user/assistant message(s), about {tokens} tokens)
sessionRewind.toast.draftKept: ; the composer already had content, so it was kept
sessionRewind.toast.refillDraft: The composer already had content, so it was kept
sessionRewind.toast.rescueDone: Restored {restored} file(s) from the rescue point
sessionRewind.drawer.title: Rewind panel
sessionRewind.drawer.hintRewind: To rewind to a message, click "Rewind to here" on its row, or use the button below to open the candidate list.
sessionRewind.rescues.confirm: Restore {n} file(s)? The current content is saved as a new rescue point first.
sessionRewind.trash.title: Trash
sessionRewind.trash.confirm: Restore {n} file(s)? The current content is saved as a new rescue point first.
sessionRewind.trash.clearConfirm: Permanently delete {n} file(s) ({bytes})? This cannot be undone; restore them first if you want to keep them.
sessionRewind.toast.trashPartial: Restored {restored} file(s) from the trash; {failed} failed
sessionRewind.settings.confirmOnList: Confirm before executing from the list
sessionRewind.settings.confirmOnListHint: When off, the default conversation-only mode runs directly; file mode always asks first.
sessionRewind.settings.recall: ↑/↓ recalls earlier prompts in the composer
sessionRewind.settings.recallHint: In an empty draft (or with the caret on the first line) ↑ recalls the last prompt you sent, ↓ walks forward and restores your own draft at the bottom; it only fills the draft — never rewinds, never sends.
sessionRewind.health.auditRecordsAtLeast: at least {count} record(s) readable (read limit reached)
sessionRewind.health.orphansSkipped: cannot enumerate live sessions ({workspaces} unreadable workspace(s), {unknownLayout} unknown layout(s)); orphan cleanup was skipped; kept {kept} unknown item(s)
sessionRewind.error.busy: Stop the current turn first (Esc), then rewind.
sessionRewind.error.badTarget: That message could not be located.
sessionRewind.error.notOnSurface: That message was shadowed by a compaction summary and cannot be rewound.
sessionRewind.error.filesConflict: Files differ from the expected state; nothing was changed.
sessionRewind.error.filesRescueFailed: Could not create the rescue point; nothing was changed.
sessionRewind.error.filesFailed: Some files could not be processed.
sessionRewind.dialog.settling: Stopping the running turn, then rewinding…
sessionRewind.toast.stoppedTurn: , and the running turn was stopped
sessionRewind.confirm.resend: Send this message again right after rewinding
sessionRewind.confirm.resendHint: Use this to retry a turn; to change the text, edit it in the composer instead.
sessionRewind.toast.resent: , and the message was sent again
sessionRewind.confirm.stateChanges: Session state changed inside this range: {list}. Rewinding only withdraws messages; these stay as they are.
sessionRewind.confirm.stateHint: Adjust plan/goal/todo state by hand if you need it rolled back too.
sessionRewind.settings.saveFailedStorage: Local storage is unavailable — changes apply only to this window
sessionRewind.error.trashNotFound: Trash record not found (it may have been restored or cleared).
